method: Read structural-context and ranker-capacity tests without rerunning full tests

findings.title: Generic detail title can be borrowed across an aside boundary
findings.cause: cardTitle ancestor stop selector omits aside and role=complementary; heading branch validation only checks the title against the outer container and does not validate the control branch.
findings.expected: Do not create supplemental card-title evidence across the complementary semantic region. Without other evidence, this generic detail link should remain unclassified.
findings.impact: An unrelated sidebar detail link becomes an application/control recommendation and receives a borrowed title. The source action is retained; no automatic execution was observed.
findings.recommendedFix: Stop generic card-title ascent at all matching semantic content boundaries, including aside/role=complementary, and add a regression case retaining legitimate plain-div cards.

otherBoundedObservations: New title text is obtained through staticText and rejects editable ancestors; no actual input value property is introduced in inspected paths.
Supplemental classification retains source actions and performs existing script/HTTP(S)/dangerous-URL checks before new classifications.
Supplemental snapshot serializes the new evidence; page-session recomputes it with fresh per-check caches.
Capacity fill runs after destination/control deduplication and prior category diversity selection, is bounded by six, and shares the same unique list as overflow.
